name: Coin Tip Button
description: Tip button that on click squashes into a slot while a 3D-looking coin flips in an arc into it, then reveals a thank-you message before resetting.
contents: Success message revealed after the coin lands
behavior: Click shakes the button and collapses it into a slot
Coin flips in a randomized parabolic arc with shine, driven by requestAnimationFrame
Success text appears with particle dots, then everything resets after about 1.5 seconds
Clicks are ignored while the animation runs
editableByProps: Coin size and flip duration in frames

needsCodeEdit.where: w-[9.5rem] class on the button element

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Button uses the Quicksand font family name but does not import it
